summary: A near-verbatim copy of a white paper from the ESnet X.500/X.400 Task Force with recommendations for the first phase of deploying OSI Directory (X.500) and Message Handling (X.400) services in the ESnet research community. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A group of science network people write down a plan for starting up electronic phone books and mail services, so their sites can use them together.
